title: Run the tasks in order
prompt: The starter defines the five tasks of the nightly shipments job and what each one needs. Write the rest of `solve(shipments, shipment_events, deliveries)` so it runs every task and returns one row per task: its name in `task` and the number of rows its output has in `rows`.
rules: A task runs only after every task it needs, and gets their outputs as arguments, in the order its list names them. The tasks are listed in no useful order.
Run each task once. Return all five tasks; `rows` is a bigint.
hints: Work out a run order first: repeatedly pick the tasks whose needs have all been placed.
Keep each task's output in a dict by name, and call the function with `*[outputs[d] for d in needs]`.
Count each output as you go and build the result with `spark.createDataFrame(results, "task STRING, rows BIGINT")`.
